title: Answer to Question: Bush's Tour of the Region
text:
Answer to Question

Bush's Tour of the Region

Question: George Bush, the American President, begins tomorrow, Wednesday, his Middle East tour, starting with Palestine on 9/1/2008, then on to Kuwait, Bahrain, the Emirates and Saudi Arabia, then Egypt on 16/1/2008, after which he returns to Washington.

This visit has been accompanied by a propaganda campaign, especially from the Abbas Authority, that Bush is coming to bring about a state for the Authority possessing sovereignty and authority alongside the state of the Jews. So how true is that?

Answer: Whoever follows the circumstances of the visit that Bush is making finds the following:

1 - It is taking place in the election year in the United States of America, when the American President's ability to take international decisions is at its minimum. For this reason Britain, when it was playing a direct role competing with America in international politics, especially in the fifties and sixties of the last century, used to fabricate events in confrontation with America in the election year of the American presidents' terms, when the preoccupation of the presidents and their parties is directed in large part towards electoral purposes. Rarely has an American president succeeded in a vital decision in international politics in an election year.

2 - It is taking place while the state of the Jews is anxious at the (coolness) of the United States militarily towards the Iranian nuclear crisis, especially after the American intelligence report which (acquitted) Iran of seeking to possess nuclear weapons. This matter is a focus of alarm for the state of the Jews, and therefore they prepared for Bush's visit a special file on the Iranian nuclear subject, after (secret) deliberations between the Israeli security and political agencies held on 6/1/2008, as the newspaper (Yedioth Ahronoth) reported. The state of the Jews has spent exhausting efforts in heating up the international atmosphere, especially the American one, towards what it alleges of Iranian nuclear weapons, at a time when the United States does not want military heating up towards Iran; for arranging matters with Iran through political work is an important matter for America, due to Iran's positive stance towards America on the subject of Afghanistan, and also for the sake of the repeated negotiating stages concerning Iraq.

The Jews realised after the mentioned report that America had found in the report a suitable way out of military heating up towards Iran, which made the state of the Jews anxious and produced a reaction in the Jewish lobby in the United States. Nor did Bush's latest statement calm it: (It is important that the inhabitants of the region realise that all options regarding Iran are still on the table), alluding to the military option; but he added after that: (However, I believe that we can settle this problem diplomatically).

3 - The visit came at a time when the Democratic Party is waging a fierce (electoral) war over the failure of Bush and the Republican Party in foreign policy, and saying that America has become hated in the Middle East region, which is vital for America because of the oil reservoir it contains. This is in addition to what the Democratic Party raises about the Bush administration exposing American soldiers in conflict areas to danger and not caring for them.

At this time came Bush's visit to occupied Palestine and to the Gulf, then Egypt:

As for occupied Palestine, that is, the state of the Jews, Bush wants to relieve the anxiety of the state of the Jews resulting from the intelligence report, and to give them promises and guarantees that America will not allow Iran to possess nuclear weapons, in addition to supplying them with advanced weapons and financial grants.

This is in addition to providing security for them by way of the Abbas Authority confronting any security disturbance to the state of the Jews in the West Bank, then Bush tasking Mubarak with the truce (tahdi'ah) talks with Hamas in Gaza, in addition to the subject of the prisoner Shalit.

By that he will have calmed the fears of the Jews regarding Iranian nuclear weapons, and rendered them security services: from the Abbas Authority in the West Bank by preventing any security disturbance to the state of the Jews, and from Hamas in Gaza by way of Egypt's talks with it on the subject of the truce and the prisoner Shalit.

And all of this is reflected on the Jewish lobby in the United States in terms of the electoral situation.

As for the Gulf, the visit is directed at what the Democratic Party raises. Bush shows them by his visit that America's situation in the region is accepted in a friendly manner and is not hated as the Democratic Party (claims). This is in addition to Bush's visit to the American soldiers in these countries and showing concern for them. And it is not unlikely that he will make a visit to Iraq, even if it is not announced in the schedule of his visits, and meet with the troops there.

As for Egypt, it is the fragrant finale (misk al-khitam) for Bush, for Mubarak is the one entrusted with American interests in the region and the Arab cover for them, and the political (spring) for excluding or (limiting) any European influence competing with American influence.

What the Palestinian Authority is doing in deluding the people that Bush's visit will bring them manna and quails, and bring about for them an entity and a state, borders and sovereignty.. is like one who stretches out his palms towards water so that it may reach his mouth, but it will not reach it! Bush came to please the Jews by providing them with material and security services, not to bring about sovereignty and authority for Mahmoud Abbas. Even what is rumoured about the evacuation of settlements: these that they talk about are scattered mobile houses established for such a purpose, to be bartered against the humiliating concession from the Authority in exchange for a mobile house here and a house there, so much so that the Jews themselves call them random, un(lawful) settlement outposts!

As for Bush's initiative which he announced, of bringing about a statelet for the Authority alongside the state of the Jews occupying Palestine, Bush himself has come to realise that the election year is not a year for implementing his initiative, bad as it is. He stated shortly before his trip: «Even if the Israeli and Palestinian leaders do not reach a peace agreement by the end of this year, I am optimistic that we can define the broad steps for the state of Palestine»! And it is known that broad lines mean continuing the humiliating negotiation with the Jews, with concession after concession, until the broad lines become broad streets full of concessions.

Bush comes to Palestine for calm and to provide security for the Jews, and to reassure them that Bush and the Jews are joined together in one bond, and that they are in one line of defence against the alleged Iranian nuclear weapons,

And he comes to the Gulf to ridicule the views of the Democratic Party in its electoral campaign that the American administration is hated in the vital oil region,

And he concludes his visit with Egypt, the largest Arab state in the region, to show how much weight the Bush administration and the Republican Party have!

Bush is conducting the electoral campaign of the Republican Party setting out from our lands: from blessed Palestine, the vital Gulf, and Egypt al-Kinanah... Our lands have become not only part of the foreign policy of the colonialist states, but also part of their domestic policy! This humiliation would not have been but for rulers in our lands who have sold their Deen for their worldly life, nay, for the worldly life of others; so woe to them for what they do.

Palestine will not be restored by the rulers and the Authority crawling to receive Bush, nor by their scrambling to negotiate with the Jews. Rather, what will restore Palestine is the march of the armies, and their setting out in Jihad across the borders.

What will restore Palestine is the sincere, Mujahid ruler who asks Allah, glorified be He, for one of the two best outcomes.

What will restore Palestine is the Khaleefah by whom one is protected and behind whom one fights.

What will restore Palestine is a mighty, honourable rule, a rightly guided Khilafah on the method of the Prophethood.

Thus Palestine will return, and this is the straight path leading to Palestine, all of Palestine.

"Indeed, this is the true certainty."

30 Dhul Hijjah 1428 AH

08/01/2008 CE
